title: What are Trophic Levels?
text: Trophic levels represent the position an organism occupies in a food chain. Level 1 = Producers (plants), Level 2 = Primary consumers (herbivores), Level 3+ = Secondary/Tertiary consumers (carnivores).

title: Identify the Producer
text: Look for the organism that gets its energy from the sun through photosynthesis. In this food web, grass is the producer (Trophic Level 1).

title: Count the Levels
text: Count upward from producers: Grass → Herbivores (grasshopper, mouse, rabbit) → Small carnivores (frog, snake) → Top predators (hawk, owl). How many distinct levels is that?
